replication.target_description: Experiment 4: main effect of articulatory suppression; corresponding replication ANOVA.

n.sample_role: participants in target experiment; full factorial ANOVA sample
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; experiment sample is consistent with target ANOVA degrees of freedom.
n.quote: The sample consists of 24 participants (12 women and 12 men, aged 15 to 64)

reported_success.quote: However, the articulatory suppression effect, word length effect, presentation speed effect, and delay effect did not replicate.

notes:
Statistics retained as printed. Original and replication tests extracted independently. No metric conversion. Original uses one-tailed directional tests. Replication presents audiovisual stimuli; source tables label outcome lists but methods and scoring concern item/order recall. General Discussion p. r10 incorrectly says the original had no suppression effect; original p. 17 prints a significant suppression main effect. Abstract explicitly says suppression did not replicate; failed maps that stated verdict.
Completion source review (n_o): Explicit experiment-specific 24 participants, full design allocation and participant-level ANOVA establish the model sample; not a whole-paper recruitment count and not inferred from df. No arithmetic-derived N.
